comment: A bundled template's files are classpath resources, and a native image ships
only the resources it was told about. Without these, a native binary embedding
the builder builds clean, lists the template, asks every question, and then
cannot find a single file to write -- a green build is not evidence for this.
It travels with the module rather than with whatever binary embeds it, so
anything depending on vexelray-framework-template gets it. It arrived from
mainframe-template with the resources it describes: the globs name the classpath
root Catalogue reads, and VexelDesktopTest.theManifestAndTheFolderAgree keeps the
